instruction: Translate this into standard English as best you can.

S_slice_only (PRIMARY, matches James's o.content: instruction + blank line + the scene packet verbatim; no policy, taxonomy, rule, or file marker

P_with_policy (SECONDARY).content: instruction + policy.prose_rehydrate_v2 + taxonomy.hinge_anchors_v0_1 + rule.load_bearing_anchor_promotion_v1 + scene packet (the original frozen requests)

deviations: Codex adapter requires a non-empty system message (CODEX_BAD_REQUEST pre-dispatch on all 18 v1 requests, 0 s, nothing sent; preserved in runs/astra|luna/failed). v2 adds system "You are a helpful assistant." for astra/luna only; Qwen has no system message.

Qwen v1 (max_tokens 12000) exhausted the budget on reasoning with no content on ch05_slice1_s1 (kept as FAILED); run stopped and restarted as v2 with max_tokens 32000, files prefixed qwen32k_. Temperature 0.3 unchanged.

2026-10-22: James clarified his original runs sent ONLY the slices (no prose_rehydrate policy/taxonomy/rule). The frozen requests (arm P) therefore do not match his condition. Arm S (slice-only) added as PRIMARY; arm P kept as a secondary arm, which measures whether the policy context is load-bearing. Arm P returns already collected stay valid for that comparison; stems without '_only' are arm P.
historical_design: one fresh context per call; user message = request text only; no system prompt; 3 samples per model; sources and overlay are grader-only, never sent
historical_design_caveat: Intended design, not proof of host isolation.
scoring: Single partially blinded grader; scoring and capture chronology is reported, not independently timestamp-proved.
model_labels: Collection labels, not independently verified backend identities.
browser: Host defaults and sampling uncontrolled; DreamGen had existing host context; Perplexity used Search mode.
